cases.prompt: Write a LinkedIn post (under 80 words) announcing a co-living investing masterclass for first-time landlords. Warm, direct, one call to action.
cases.rubric: Under 80 words, one clear CTA, mentions co-living and first-time landlords, no hype words like 'guaranteed' or 'passive income overnight'.

cases.prompt: Write a two-line SMS to a tenant applicant confirming their viewing is Thursday at 5pm and asking them to reply YES to confirm.
cases.rubric: Two lines max, includes Thursday 5pm, asks for a YES reply, polite, no emojis required.

cases.prompt: Write an ad headline (under 12 words) for furnished rooms in Tampa with utilities included.
cases.rubric: Under 12 words, names Tampa, conveys furnished + utilities included, no ALL CAPS, no exclamation spam.

cases.prompt: Write a three-sentence email to a vendor asking for two references before we accept their roofing quote.
cases.rubric: Exactly three sentences, asks for two references, courteous, does not accept or reject the quote.

cases.prompt: Write a 40-word Instagram caption for a before/after photo of a renovated shared kitchen.
cases.rubric: Around 40 words (30–50), references the before/after, positive tone, ends with a light CTA or question, at most one hashtag.
